Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>","messageHeadline":"feat(plp): split ZimmCheckbox atom, rename ZimmSizeFilter, use OOTB grid","oid":"7a0aefca4a3f5b6474e5d72b2fe5854afc0d6fbb"},{"authoredDate":"2026-09-21T00:33:21Z","authors":[{"email":"bryan.ian.de.vera@accenture.com","id":"U_kgDOE498Fg","login":"bryanian09","name":"Bryan De vera"},{"email":"noreply@anthropic.com","id":"MDQ6VXNlcjgxODQ3","login":"claude","name":"Claude Sonnet 4.6"}],"committedDate":"2026-09-21T00:33:21Z","messageBody":"On a leaf category page (/clothing/dresses) the drawer's Category
accordion was showing sub-categories (Day Dresses, Denim Dresses…)
instead of siblings (Dresses, Tops, Skirts…) with the current selection
highlighted.

Root cause: three interacting bugs —

1. The `category` useEffect set `categoryOptions` from `category.categories`
   on every page, including leaf pages where those are sub-categories rather
   than siblings.

2. The persist-to-localStorage effect excluded `categoryId` from its deps
   to avoid a stale write, which also prevented cross-seeding — the sibling
   list written on the parent page (/clothing) was never stored under the leaf
   key (clothing-dresses) for hard-refresh recovery.

3. `resolvedCategoryOptions` fell back to `category?.categories` when
   `categoryOptions` was undefined, which would surface sub-categories on a
   first-visit direct load of a leaf page.

Fixes:
- Guard the `category` effect with an `isRootOrTopLevel` check derived from
  `parentCategoryId` — leaf pages are skipped; only root/top-level pages
  write their children into `categoryOptions`.
- Restore `categoryId` to the persist effect's dependency array. On
  navigation from /clothing → /clothing/dresses the effect fires with the
  sibling list still in `categoryOptions` (the leaf guard above prevents it
  being overwritten) and writes it under the leaf key — correct cross-seeding.
- Narrow the `resolvedCategoryOptions` fallback so `category?.categories` is
  only used on root/top-level pages; leaf pages fall back to `[]` instead of
  sub-categories.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>","messageHeadline":"fix(plp): show sibling categories in filter drawer Category accordion","oid":"d88114a65c3d46d376707e50b4462fe0c0b8279d"},{"authoredDate":"2026-09-21T00:46:59Z","authors":[{"email":"bryan.ian.de.vera@accenture.com","id":"U_kgDOE498Fg","login":"bryanian09","name":"Bryan De vera"},{"email":"noreply@anthropic.com","id":"MDQ6VXNlcjgxODQ3","login":"claude","name":"Claude Sonnet 4.6"}],"committedDate":"2026-09-21T00:46:59Z","messageBody":"…er race

The categoryId-change effect reads localStorage before the persist effect
can write to it (effects run in declaration order). This meant the sibling
list was only available in localStorage after a full re-render cycle, so
reopening the filter drawer on the leaf page showed an empty Category
accordion instead of the correct siblings.

Fix: write categoryOptions to localStorage under the target category's key
inside applyFilters(), before navigate() is called. By the time the leaf
page's categoryId-change effect reads from localStorage, the sibling list
is already there.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>","messageHeadline":"fix(plp): cross-seed sibling list before navigate to avoid effect ord…","oid":"58f573a7ff9c153be596c179f11f5b3220b1bd24"},{"authoredDate":"2026-09-21T01:08:20Z","authors":[{"email":"bryan.ian.de.vera@accenture.com","id":"U_kgDOE498Fg","login":"bryanian09","name":"Bryan De vera"},{"email":"noreply@anthropic.com","id":"MDQ6VXNlcjgxODQ3","login":"claude","name":"Claude Sonnet 4.6"}],"committedDate":"2026-09-21T01:08:20Z","messageBody":"…on on leaf pages

The Category accordion was missing on leaf pages because categoryOptions
depended on localStorage being seeded before the categoryId-change effect
ran — an effect-order race that failed on first visit, hard refresh, and
any scenario where the prior navigation state was lost.

Root cause: category.categories always holds the CURRENT category's children
(sub-categories), not its siblings. Siblings live in the PARENT category's
children array. Without a direct fetch of the parent, the sibling list was
only available through fragile localStorage cross-seeding.

Fix: add useCategory({ id: parentCategoryIdFromPath }) on every leaf page.

```
} & ({ role?: never; ariaChecked?: never } | { role: 'checkbox' | 'radio'; ariaChecked: boolean }); // `aria-checked` is a selectable control that never exposes what it is set to. // union so the role and its state cannot be supplied apart: a `role="checkbox"` with no // button and never conveys whether it is currently applied. ```

CONFIRMED by my own direct read (independently, not just relaying the sub-agent that flagged the same line).

**On the union mechanics themselves — assessed, NOT a violation.** I want to be explicit since the brief asked me to judge soundness: this **is** a real, working discriminated union, not "optional props in a trenchcoat." The `{role?:never; ariaChecked?:never} | {role:'checkbox'|'radio'; ariaChecked:boolean}` shape is the standard TS "correlated-optional via `never`" idiom. I checked both failure directions by hand: `{role:'checkbox'}` alone fails both branches (branch 1 rejects `'checkbox'` against `never`; branch 2 requires `ariaChecked`), and `{ariaChecked:true}` alone fails both branches the same way — so TypeScript genuinely rejects supplying one without the other at any JSX call site. It doesn't use a synthetic `kind` tag the way typescript.md's own textbook example does, but `role` itself works as the discriminant and narrows correctly. I looked for a hole and didn't find one — reporting that plainly rather than manufacturing a finding.
